title: Zone 51: Virus Nocturnus
description: Years after a secret experiment at Area 51 went wrong, Tijuana stands empty. Search abandoned houses and shops for supplies and the notes families left behind, and survive the fast, vampire-like infected that hunt when the red moon rises.
features: Explore abandoned Tijuana and enter its houses and shops
Day and night cycle with Red Eclipse nights and sandstorms
Fast infected, dog packs, Climbers, the Revived and the Alpha boss
Level up and choose new upgrades as you survive
Play on keyboard and mouse or Xbox and PlayStation controllers
